grammar.title: Plenty of with 有的是
grammar.pattern: (某地方) + 有的是 + 名词
grammar.explanation: 有的是 (yǒudeshì) means "there's plenty of, no shortage of" — used to reassure someone there's more than enough of something. It replaces 有 when you want to stress abundance.

sentences.en: There's plenty of good food here.
Don't be afraid, we've got plenty of solutions.

sentences.zh: 现在有的是年轻人喜欢这种音乐。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài yǒudeshì niánqīng rén xǐhuan zhè zhǒng yīnyuè.
sentences.en: Nowadays there are plenty of young people who like this kind of music.
